washing_state: Initial manufactured laminate; no durability laundering or aging reported
limitations: Table 1 reports the measured LOI and explicitly inert DTG maximum for the same five thin glass-fabric laminate compositions. The separately tested 6.5% and 9.8% DDM-DOPO specimens are approximately 2 mm thick and have no numerical TG entries; their LOIs are not transferred to the thin specimens. Table 3 is headed epoxy matrix composition and gives ED-22 = 100, curing agent = 5 and additive = 1.5 or 3, whereas the sample labels and conclusion use percentages. These source-native recipes and labels are retained without converting them to total-laminate additive fractions. The source specifies 50 mass% prepreg binder and two glass-fabric layers, but does not supply a separate measured additive fraction in the finished laminate. The LOI column is headed thin samples; the 75 × 25 × 0.4 mm dimensions belong to the downward-flame-spread setup and are not assigned as LOI specimen dimensions. The TG method permits aluminum or platinum crucibles without identifying the pan for each series. Table 1 gives unspecified ±2 °C uncertainty for all inert DTG maxima; these are not labeled standard deviations. The LOI method accuracy of ±0.1% is not a specimen SD. Table 1 residue entries lack an explicit atmosphere header even though the source tests both argon and helium/oxygen; those values remain source-native and are excluded from canonical residues. Approximate residue differences and plotted curves are not converted into additional measurements. No laundering or aging state is inferred. The SI is described by the article as SEM and X-ray energy-dispersive spectra; access and review scope are documented separately. Both DDM-DOPO pairs are excluded because Figure 1b places the 3% DTG minimum left of the 1.5% minimum, whereas Table 1 reports 444 °C versus 438 °C. No independent printed temperature anchor identifies which value is wrong; neither is replaced by a graph-derived value.
sample_state: GFRER; two-layer thin GFRER laminate; initial state
composition: Table 3 epoxy-matrix recipe: ED-22 100; curing agent #9 5; none absent. The table uses a mass-fraction heading and the specimen label uses percent; no normalized whole-laminate additive concentration is calculated. Two glass-fabric layers, 50 mass% prepreg binder.
treatment_method: The untreated matrix recipe is ED-22 100 and curing agent #9 5 in Table 3; section 3.1 discusses ground DDM as the curing agent. No graphene solvent-dispersion step is assigned to this additive-free state. The matrix was used to prepare two layers of T-15(P)-76(92) glass fabric with fibers oriented in one direction. Prepreg binder content was 50 mass%. Cure: 100 °C for 2 h followed by 150 °C for 2 h.
source_residue_entry_raw: 59.1 ± 1.5%; Table 1; atmosphere not explicitly assigned in residue header
pairing_evidence: Table 1 assigns measured LOI 21.0% and inert DTG maximum 442 °C to the same GFRER thin-laminate row. Sections 3.1 and 3.2 identify the prepared glass-fabric slabs and their TG aliquots. Section 2.1/Figure 1a–b specifies argon for the inert series. The separately thicker high-loading formulations are excluded.
